targets.instructionsIntro: Create this TXT record in your domain DNS, then click Verify. Propagation can take a few minutes.
targets.guideTitle: How to add it (works with any provider)
guideSteps: Open your domain provider dashboard (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap, Hostinger, Google Domains, etc.) and go to the DNS section.
Create a new record of type TXT.
In "Name" or "Host" paste the value below. Note: some providers append your domain automatically, so if it asks only for the subdomain use "_sentra-challenge".
In "Value" or "Content" paste the sentra-verify string. Leave TTL on automatic.
Save and come back here in 1–2 minutes to click Verify (DNS propagation is not instant).

pdf.methodologyBody: The Security Score is a weighted sum: each control carries a weight and the final score is (earned weight ÷ total weight) × 100. Here: {earned} of {total} points = {score}/100.
pdf.aiPending: Generate the AI report to include the detailed narrative analysis.
pdf.frameworksNote: Findings are classified against recognized industry frameworks: OWASP Top 10, CWE (Common Weakness Enumeration), NIST SP 800 and applicable RFCs. Each control lists its reference(s) for traceability and remediation.
pdf.disclaimer: This report is based on a passive, non-intrusive external analysis of the domain public surface on the stated date. It does not replace an authorized penetration test or an internal audit. Confidential document intended solely for the verified domain owner.

monitor.title: Continuous monitoring
monitor.subtitle: Automatic watch over your domains security posture.
monitor.intro: When you enable monitoring, Sentra re-scans the domain periodically and emails you if its security degrades: the score drops, a control fails (SPF, DMARC, HSTS…) or the certificate nears expiry. You find out before it becomes a problem.
monitor.emailNote: Alerts are sent to your account email. Monitoring is a Pro feature and applies only to verified domains.
monitor.empty: You have not added any domains yet. Go to Audit to start.

surface.title: Surface map
surface.subtitle: Discover what your domain exposes to the internet.
surface.intro: Sentra discovers your external footprint: subdomains (via Certificate Transparency and DNS), open ports and services, and detected technologies. It is the first step to understand your attack surface the way an attacker would — passively and on domains you already verified.
surface.disclaimer: Passive discovery over a verified domain. Port checks are limited to common services on the root domain. This is not a penetration test.
surface.empty: You have no verified domains. Go to Audit, add and verify a domain to map its surface.
